name: region_flavor_4

name: taunt_1_day_0
Station Scavenging: The carpets upstairs are not ready to meet your boots.

name: taunt_1_day_1
Station Scavenging: The guest list is not printed yet. No promises about your name being on it.

name: taunt_1_rep_0
Station Scavenging: Even the leftovers have standards. First, get someone upstairs to remember your name.

name: taunt_1_rep_1
Station Scavenging: The councillors do not know you. The cleaners will not vouch for you either.

name: taunt_2_day_0
Station Scavenging: Halt. Your turn for a temporary visitor's pass has not come.

name: taunt_2_day_1
Station Scavenging: Join the queue. Making it move is outside our jurisdiction.

name: taunt_2_rep_0
Station Scavenging: No record of service. We can always open a trespassing file instead.

name: taunt_2_rep_1
Station Scavenging: Your credentials lack weight. Try not to become evidence before entering the evidence store.

name: taunt_3_day_0
Station Scavenging: Not yet comrade. Learn to wait for the signal.

name: taunt_3_day_1
Station Scavenging: Even the revolution has a rota. Your name is not on tonight's.

name: taunt_3_rep_0
Station Scavenging: Loud slogans do not earn supplies. Help first.

name: taunt_3_rep_1
Station Scavenging: You say we are all comrades. The quartermaster has not agreed yet.

name: taunt_4_day_0
Station Scavenging: This alley knows familiar faces. Yours is not one of them yet.

name: taunt_4_day_1
Station Scavenging: The back door is still shut. It does not know you either.

name: taunt_4_rep_0
Station Scavenging: Not enough street credit. Do not even ask the price of the empty crates.

name: taunt_4_rep_1
Station Scavenging: Build a reputation first. We sell information not introductions.

name: taunt_4_exchange_0
Station Scavenging: Never found the exchange and already asking for our back door?

name: taunt_4_exchange_1
Station Scavenging: Find the underground exchange first. Regulars know which alley holds the stock.

name: event_upper_gala_title
Station Scavenging: Champagne Upstairs

name: event_upper_gala_desc
Station Scavenging: The elite are celebrating and the guards are fetching coats. Unclaimed supplies crowd the service entrance; even the medical crates got an invitation.

name: event_upper_audit_title
Station Scavenging: The White-Glove Audit

name: event_upper_audit_desc
Station Scavenging: Councillors may lose jewellery. Cleaners may not lose a checklist. Every crate is being counted tonight, along with every unfamiliar pair of hands.

name: event_upper_baths_title
Station Scavenging: Bathhouse Turnover

name: event_upper_baths_desc
Station Scavenging: The private baths are changing water and supplies. Fresh towels need signatures; the medical deliveries by the back door are still waiting for theirs.

name: event_security_shift_title
Station Scavenging: The Shift-Change Sprint

name: event_security_shift_desc
Station Scavenging: The outgoing shift is leaving and the incoming shift is looking for keys. Three handover sheets later, nobody has claimed the supplies in the corner.

name: event_security_stocktake_title
Station Scavenging: More Rifles Than Staff

name: event_security_stocktake_desc
Station Scavenging: Security is counting its stock. Ammunition and sealed cases fill the corridors. Patrols have been asked to count unfamiliar faces while they are at it.

name: event_security_cameras_title
Station Scavenging: Snow on Every Screen

name: event_security_cameras_desc
Station Scavenging: The cameras have all developed an interest in static. Technicians hunt for the fault while the duty room's household supplies go unwatched.

name: event_revolution_relay_title
Station Scavenging: Pass the Crate Comrade

name: event_revolution_relay_desc
Station Scavenging: Supplies are being relayed through the maintenance tunnels. The crates arrived before their escorts. A few interested eyes followed them in.

name: event_revolution_rehearsal_title
Station Scavenging: Mandatory Slogan Practice

name: event_revolution_rehearsal_desc
Station Scavenging: Everyone has been called away to practise a particularly loud slogan. The workshop is quiet at last. Its tools are no longer being borrowed by three people at once.

name: event_revolution_password_title
Station Scavenging: Yesterday's Password

name: event_revolution_password_desc
Station Scavenging: The password changed. Nobody told the quartermaster. He is checking everyone and putting better locks on the better crates.

name: event_black_auction_title
Station Scavenging: After the Last Bid

name: event_black_auction_desc
Station Scavenging: The auction is over and unsold stock is moving into the back alley. The goods look promising. The disappointed bidders have not gone far either.

name: event_black_blackout_title
Station Scavenging: Lights Out Business On

name: event_black_blackout_desc
Station Scavenging: Another circuit has tripped. Traders search for spare lamps while electronics and sealed stock share one conveniently dark passage.

name: event_black_informant_title
Station Scavenging: A Tip Sold Twice

name: event_black_informant_desc
Station Scavenging: The informant promised good stock tonight. That part was true. So was the identical tip he sold to the patrol.
